scenarios.name: Restaurant booking - evening table with weather check
scenarios.description: Customer books a table for 2 at 7pm. Before recommending seating the agent must check the weather and availability (unordered). Before confirming, the agent must call book_table.

turns.message: Hi, I'd like to book a table for tonight

turns.golden_response: Of course! How many guests will be joining and what time would you prefer?
checks: Agent asks about party size or preferred time

turns.message: 2 people, around 7pm. How's the weather looking for outdoor seating?

tools.name: check_weather

when.description: Canonical time descriptor; the test requires the exact string 'tonight'.

tools.expected_response: Tonight's forecast: cold and rainy, 45F, chance of showers.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.expected_response: Available tables at 7pm for 2: corner (indoor), window (indoor), patio (outdoor).

turns.golden_response: Tonight's forecast shows cold and rainy weather. I'd recommend our indoor seating - we have some lovely window tables available.
checks: Agent reports weather conditions for the evening
Agent makes a seating recommendation based on weather
turns.divergence_note: Weather and availability come from tools; the STRUCTURE (report weather + recommend seating) matters, not the specific details.

turns.message: OK, indoor sounds good. Can I get the corner table?

turns.golden_response: Great choice! I've booked the corner table for 2 at 7pm, indoor seating. Your confirmation number is A1234. Is there anything else I can help with?
checks: Agent confirms the booking with correct details (2 people, 7pm, indoor)
Agent provides a confirmation number or reference
Agent confirms the specific table requested (corner table)

scenarios.expected_outcome: Booking confirmed for 2 people at 7pm, indoor seating, corner table
outcome_checks: A booking was made (not just discussed)
Confirmation number or reference was provided
